nodes.name: Sklearn Multioutput Public API Shell
nodes.description: High-level MultiOutputClassifier, MultiOutputRegressor, ClassifierChain, and RegressorChain selection, callback-payload, and fitted-state atoms above per-output estimator, chain prediction, CV, and metadata-routing boundaries.

nodes.name: multioutput_estimator_catalog
nodes.description: Expose public sklearn multioutput meta-estimator names useful for framework-level selection.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom returns a fixed public estimator-name tuple and does not inspect data.

nodes.name: multioutput_estimator_family
nodes.description: Return the multioutput family represented by a public estimator name.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom performs a dictionary lookup over fixed estimator names.

nodes.name: multioutput_estimator_boundary
nodes.description: Return the per-output estimator, chain prediction, CV, or metadata-routing boundary represented by a public multioutput estimator.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom performs a constant-time branch over fixed estimator names.

nodes.name: multioutput_estimator_methods
nodes.description: Expose public methods useful for high-level multioutput routing.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom returns a fixed public-method tuple for each covered multioutput estimator.

nodes.name: multioutput_fit_method_payload
nodes.description: Expose a public multioutput fit payload for finite dense inputs without executing delegated estimator callbacks.
nodes.type_signature: (estimator: object, X: object, y: object, sample_weight: object = None, fit_params: dict[str, object] | None = None) -> dict[str, object]
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom validates dense fit inputs and packages references without fitting per-output estimators.

nodes.name: multioutput_prediction_method_payload
nodes.description: Expose a public multioutput prediction-like payload without executing estimator callbacks.
nodes.type_signature: (estimator: object, method_name: str, X: object) -> dict[str, object]
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom validates dense prediction input and packages references, leaving per-output responses and chain augmentation to sklearn.

nodes.name: multioutput_fit_return_self
nodes.description: Return the fitted public multioutput estimator object from the public fit shell.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom checks fitted marker attributes and returns the same estimator object.

nodes.name: multioutput_fitted_state_summary
nodes.description: Expose fitted output-count, delegate-estimator, class, chain-order, and feature metadata after delegated multioutput execution.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom exposes already-fitted estimator and class metadata proportional to output count.

metadata.remediation_case: Case 3 and Case 4 public multioutput meta-estimator shells over per-output estimator, chain prediction, CV, and metadata-routing callback boundaries
limitations: Per-output estimators, chain estimators, cross-validated previous-output features, metadata routing, partial-fit mutation, prediction, probability, and scoring remain delegated behavior.

The shell models finite dense public API routing and compact fitted-state packaging, not estimator training, chain augmentation, cross_val_predict execution, per-output prediction, probability, partial-fit, or scoring internals.
